title: Ice and Snow Disaster Emergency UAV Inspection
title_en: Ice and Snow Disaster Emergency UAV Inspection
description:
Ice and Snow Disaster Emergency UAV Inspection
In a -15 C severe-cold environment, State Grid used our VTOL fixed-wing UAVs carrying LiDAR to inspect 400 km of 500 kV transmission corridors, including the Yanping Line and Pingji Lines I and II. The operation used five staging areas such as Yanji City and Antu County, deployed 18 temporary takeoff and landing points, and completed comprehensive data acquisition through 3D laser scanning. It identified 12 severe icing defects on towers and fittings, completed LiDAR scanning of designated line sections, and generated 12 rapid real-time condition reports, providing accurate data for ultra-high-voltage line maintenance in extreme cold weather.
